title: Message too long
text: The maximum size of a NAS message for NR connected to 5GCN is specified in 3GPPTS38.323[29]
The maximum size of a NAS message for E-UTRA connected to 5GCN is specified 3GPPTS36.323[25]
The maximum size of a NAS message for non-3GPP access connected to 5GCN is specified in 3GPPTS24.502[18]
